exposure: number of per-vaginal examinations before cesarean section
allocation to labor and delivery ward
type of cesarean section (elective vs. emergency)
timing of rupture of the membrane
cohort: 42 women who underwent cesarean section, with 21 experiencing pelvic abscess and 21 matched controls without surgical site infections
finding: The number of vaginal examinations and emergency cesarean section were strongly associated with pelvic abscess, while allocation to the labor and delivery ward was the most statistically significant risk factor.
